name: afterglide
description: A controller-first Xbox streaming client for Steam Deck and desktop
author: Arthur Ramos

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite" "tsup --watch" "wait-on tcp:5173 dist/main/main.cjs dist/main/preload.cjs && cross-env AFTERGLIDE_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run clean && vite build && tsup
scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "tests/**/*.ts" "*.config.ts" package.json tsconfig.json index.html README.md PRODUCT.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/INSTALL.md docs/adr/0001-electron-webrtc-desktop.md packaging/flatpak/README.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/release.yml .github/dependabot.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "tests/**/*.ts" "*.config.ts" package.json tsconfig.json index.html README.md PRODUCT.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/INSTALL.md docs/adr/0001-electron-webrtc-desktop.md packaging/flatpak/README.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/release.yml .github/dependabot.yml
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage tar.gz --x64 --publish never
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run check:installer && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

entry.Name: Afterglide
entry.Comment: Play your Xbox from Steam Deck
